case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hello Ms Aigner,

You asked to keep things practical and clear, so here is our answer in the same spirit: we want to award this shaft to a shop that runs our parts efficiently, and your offer is a serious candidate.

On the competing offer:
Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 13.98; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.03; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it brings your price much closer to the other offer while keeping the lead time you quoted. Option B is there if a different payment term suits your shop better.

We are deciding between suppliers, so we cannot promise an award in advance. If you can work with one of these options, tell us which, and we will take it forward promptly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

thanks for the open words; we really want to run these parts for you, so I've sharpened my pencil and can offer €15.80 with DAP delivery. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €15.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hello Ms Aigner,

You said you want to run these parts for us and that you are clarifying internally, so we have made it simple for you to take to your side. Thank you for taking the competing quote into account and for sharpening your pencil.

Our revised options are below. They keep your delivery terms and DAP, and they are built around a price that works for both of us.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.20; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.25; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option A is the package we can approve: it pairs a clear unit price with a payment term that keeps the order practical for both sides, and the lead time stays as you proposed.

If a colleague has to sign off on your side, Option A is the one to put in front of them. It is a straightforward, repeatable order on the delivery basis you already quoted.

We are comparing offers carefully and would like to hear back from you on Option A.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. I've sharpened my pencil again and can offer you €15.10 per piece if we stick to the 30 days.

So, our offer is a price of €15.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Let's agree on this so we can get the machines set up for your parts.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hello Ms Aigner,

You said faster payment is welcome and that you can reflect it in the price. Option A is built around exactly that: payment in a much shorter time than your standard, at a price that reflects it.

Thank you for moving again on price. You asked which figures sit behind our position. We have no further data to add, so the options below are our answer, and they give you the choice between a faster payment and a delivered price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 13.40; payment 14 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm EXW.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.31; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 13.60; payment 14 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm FCA.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the fastest cash of the three, and the price reflects that. Option C offers the same payment speed with FCA, and Option B keeps DAP delivery for a longer payment term.

If Option A works for you, please tell us. We would be glad to run these parts with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €14.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery FCA.

Claudia Aigner
